headline: Patriots' Kraft says Macklemore performance would cross line
summary: Robert Kraft said he had Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's shows at Gillette Stadium due in part to a "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community."

headline: How will the Patriots play without A.J. Brown?
summary: Mike Reiss breaks down who steps up in A.J. Brown's absence and how training looked heading into Sunday's game against the Steelers.

headline: Patriots face uphill battle without A.J. Brown for four weeks
summary: Brown suffered a high ankle sprain in Week 1 that will keep him out of the lineup. Who will need to step up for the Patriots in his absence?

headline: Sources: Patriots' A.J. Brown to go on IR, miss at least 4 games
summary: The Patriots are placing wide receiver A.J .Brown on injured reserve due to his high ankle sprain, sidelining him for a minimum of four games, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

headline: Sources: Patriots to add DaQuan Jones on 1-year deal
summary: The Patriots are expected to sign free agent defensive tackle DaQuan Jones to a one-year deal worth up to $6 million, sources told NFL Network.

headline: Source: Patriots' A.J. Brown likely out at least 4 weeks
summary: An MRI on the right ankle of A.J. Brown on Thursday confirmed that the New England Patriots' receiver suffered a high ankle sprain in the team's season opener, and he will be out at least four weeks, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
